hotelDecisionsOfflineInfo: Decisions are never queued, so nothing is half-sent.
hotelDecisionsAcceptConfirmRule: If the client does not confirm, the date is released and their voucher goes back to them.
hotelDecisionsAcceptPriceHint: Paid to you directly, outside the app, after the client confirms.
hotelDecisionsAcceptLowerHint: A lower voucher price is optional and never higher than the quote. The client sees the new saving.
hotelDecisionsAcceptOthersLine: {count, plural, one{# other request for this date} other{# other requests for this date}}
hotelDecisionsAcceptedBody: The date is held for <n>{name}</n>, who has until <f>{deadline}</f> to confirm.
hotelDecisionsAcceptedUndoHint: The client is told in a few seconds. Undo until then.
hotelDecisionsUndoneBody: The date is released and the client was not told.
hotelDecisionsConflictBody: Another client’s approved request holds <f>{date}</f> while they confirm. You can still offer a different date.
hotelDecisionsAlreadyBody: Someone on your team or the client changed it a moment ago. This is where it stands now.
hotelDecisionsReleasedBody: The client’s voucher is no longer attached to your venue, so there is nothing to approve. The request leaves your list.
hotelDecisionsDeclineSuggestBody: The client will see a gentle message and venues that are free on the same date.
hotelDecisionsDeclineVoucherInfo: The client’s voucher goes back to them. Declining has no payment consequence.
hotelDecisionsDeclinedBody: The client has been told and their voucher is back with them.
hotelDecisionsProposeIntro: Pick one to three free dates for the same hall and session. The client has {window} to reply.
hotelDecisionsProposeHold: Every date keeps the quoted voucher price of {amount}. If a date normally costs more, you cover the difference.
hotelDecisionsProposeCount: {count, plural, =0{No dates chosen} one{# date chosen} other{# dates chosen}}
hotelDecisionsProposeEmpty: No free dates in the next {days} for this hall.
hotelDecisionsProposeNoHallBody: A service request has no hall calendar. Reply to the client in the chat to agree another day.
hotelDecisionsProposeSentBody: The request stays pending with your dates attached. If the client accepts one, a new {duration} confirm window starts.
hotelDecisionsCancelTalkBody: A new date is agreed with the client in the chat. If the date moves, the client may need a new request.
hotelDecisionsCancelVoucherInfo: The client’s voucher goes back to them. They can refund the {fee} or use it again.
hotelDecisionsCancelStrikeInfo: A reliability strike is recorded and the date opens again.
hotelDecisionsCancelNoMoney: No money moves in the app. Anything the client has already paid you is settled between the two of you.
hotelDecisionsCancelHiddenBody: Only an Admin or Manager can cancel a confirmed booking.
